finding_title: Redirect hop missing from telemetry (Two-hop redirect, second hop unlogged)
description: MAL-005 Two-hop redirect, second hop unlogged: redirect hop missing from telemetry. Affects 8 of its journeys in the baseline run.
impact: The SOC cannot reconstruct the complete redirect chain.
remediation: Improve redirect logging so every hop is captured.

finding_title: Expected detection did not fire (Ad-to-credential simulation)
description: MAL-006 Ad-to-credential simulation: expected detection did not fire. Affects 8 of its journeys in the baseline run.
impact: An attack path completed without an alert.

finding_title: Landing event missing from telemetry (Rapidly changing URL)
description: MAL-008 Rapidly changing URL: landing event missing from telemetry. Affects 8 of its journeys in the baseline run.
impact: The journey cannot be followed to its final destination.
remediation: Restore landing-event logging for rotating domains.

finding_title: Expected detection did not fire (Trusted-site redirect)
description: MAL-009 Trusted-site redirect: expected detection did not fire. Affects 8 of its journeys in the baseline run.
impact: An attack path completed without an alert.
remediation: Evaluate the final destination of the redirect chain, not only the first host.

description: MAL-010 Download after click: containment action failed. Affects 8 of its journeys in the baseline run.
impact: The suspicious destination stayed reachable after the block request.
remediation: Investigate block propagation to the enforcement point; add a failure alert and retry.

finding_title: Click not correlated to its impression (Cloaking)
description: MAL-011 Cloaking: click not correlated to its impression. Affects 8 of its journeys in the baseline run.
impact: Impression-to-click visibility is reduced; attribution of the journey is weaker.
remediation: Preserve the impression identifier through the tracker used by this journey.

finding_title: Legitimate destination flagged and blocked (Benign control, partner domain)
description: MAL-012 Benign control, partner domain: legitimate destination flagged and blocked. Affects 8 of its journeys in the baseline run.
impact: A legitimate destination was blocked, causing business disruption.
remediation: Allow-list the approved partner domain and tune the lookalike rule (R3).
